<!-- Google tag (gtag.js) -- both GA4 properties + Google Ads.
     Timing (option A with the ads lane's carve-outs, 2026-10-22, pending the
     CEO's go): on these non-ad pages gtag.js loads on the visitor's first
     scroll, tap, pointer move or key press, EXCEPT (1) thank-you pages load it
     immediately (form conversion); (2) a visit carrying an ad click id
     (gclid, gbraid, wbraid, dclid, gad_source, fbclid, msclkid) loads it at
     window load so the click cookie is written; (3) pages with a Jotform embed
     load it at window load, because typing inside the form's iframe never
     reaches this page's listeners. The config calls queue in dataLayer and
     replay the moment the script runs. -->
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());
  gtag('config', 'G-PHLC29WGVN');
  gtag('config', 'G-D3RBZZ5WPL');
  gtag('config', 'AW-354317910');
  (function(w,d){
    var done = false;
    function load(){
      if (done) return; done = true;
      var s = d.createElement('script'); s.async = true;
      s.src = 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-PHLC29WGVN';
      d.head.appendChild(s);
    }
    function atLoad(){
      if (d.readyState === 'complete') { load(); return; }
      w.addEventListener('load', load, {once: true});
      w.setTimeout(load, 5000);
    }
    var immediate = /^\/thank-you(-confirmation)?(\.html)?\/?$/.test(w.location.pathname);
    if (immediate) { load(); return; }
    if (/[?&](gclid|gbraid|wbraid|dclid|gad_source|fbclid|msclkid)=/i.test(w.location.search)) { atLoad(); return; }
    ['scroll','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown','mousemove'].forEach(function(e){
      w.addEventListener(e, load, {once: true, passive: true});
    });
    d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
      if (d.querySelector('[data-jotform-id], iframe[src*="jotform"], script[src*="jotform.com/jsform"]')) atLoad();
    });
  })(window, document);
</script>

<!-- Hotjar Tracking Code -- loads on the first scroll, tap, mouse move
     or key press (ads lane, 2026-10-20: it carries no attribution, so it
     stays out of the way of first paint). No interaction, no recording. -->
<script>
  (function(h,o,t,j){
    h.hj=h.hj||function(){(h.hj.q=h.hj.q||[]).push(arguments)};
    h._hjSettings={hjid:5016360,hjsv:6};
    var evs=['mousemove','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown','scroll'], done=false;
    function load(){
      if (done) return; done = true;
      evs.forEach(function(e){ o.removeEventListener(e, load); });
      var r=o.createElement('script');r.async=1;
      r.src=t+h._hjSettings.hjid+j+h._hjSettings.hjsv;
      o.head.appendChild(r);
    }
    evs.forEach(function(e){ o.addEventListener(e, load, {passive:true}); });
  })(window,document,'https://static.hotjar.com/c/hotjar-','.js?sv=');
</script>
